characters.mira: Young astronaut. Round head, big eyes, white suit with orange stripes, glass visor.
characters.pip: Small round robot, teal body, one glowing lens, a single antenna.

story.beat: Earth rises over the grey horizon. The lander comes down slowly.
Touchdown. The hatch opens. Mira hops out in low gravity and looks up at Earth. Pip floats out after her.
They walk to a ridge. Mira slips on the step, and Pip catches her hand and pulls her up.
A glowing crystal rises out of a crater. Mira reaches out and touches it, and a ring of light spreads outward.
The crystal shows a star map. The camera orbits the two of them as the constellation lines connect.
They cheer and look up at Earth. The title MOON SIGNAL appears and the picture fades out.
